nodes.label: Viral Maker & SVG Vector Rendering
nodes.rationale: Converts SVG text to vector paths using bundled TrueType fonts and opentype.js so rendering avoids tofu boxes on serverless/Linux environments without system fonts.

nodes.label: MattzLM Web Tools
nodes.rationale: Runs 45+ daily utilities, media downloaders, image makers, and network tools directly on a VPS without relying on unstable external APIs.

nodes.label: Anti-Slop UI & Accessibility Invariants
nodes.rationale: Caps backdrop-filter at 2, restricts fonts to Rajdhani/IBM Plex Sans/IBM Plex Mono, bans generic AI icons/badges/em-dashes, enforces explicit media dimensions, 44px touch targets, and SPA cleanup().

nodes.label: Monochrome Theme & 3D Earth Globe Engine
nodes.rationale: Enforces pure achromatic colors (R===G===B), WCAG AA >= 4.5:1 contrast, and a dependency-free Canvas 2D orthographic 3D globe with WCAG 2.5.7 single-button controls and reduced-motion support.

nodes.label: RBAC & XVIP Access Control
nodes.rationale: Separates 4 roles (owner, admin, xvip, member) across regular tools, 10 XVIP modules, and /owner console using server-side requireXvipUser() and client-side hasXvipAccess().

nodes.label: SSRF & Anti-Info-Leak Protection
nodes.rationale: Prevents SSRF via safeFetchPublic/assertPublicHttpUrl/assertPublicHost and prevents VPS info leaks by locking vps-status to owner, requiring explicit targets for vps_ip, and disabling X-Powered-By.
